---
name: New entry
about: Propose or add folklore to GRAIUL
labels: data
---

**What is it, and in which language?** A proverb, charm, riddle, carol, tale, saying or lullaby, and the language code of the text (`ro`, `hu`, `rom` …).

**The text, exactly as it is said** (with its diacritics) — or attach the contribution file from the page (tab “Add”, then tab “Export” → “Download my entries as a contribution file (JSON)”).

**Where was it collected?** The region and the county, if you know them. If you do not, say so: it will be marked “unlocated”.

**Source (required):** a book or a web page with its address, or the person you heard it from.

**Did you collect it from a person?** (always the case for charms) Who collected it, and did the person agree to this publication (`informed`), agree with the name withheld (`anonymised`), or does the text come from a published work (`published`)? See `docs/collecting-guide.md`.
